decisions.reason: As a newly launched plug-in product with its own page, it looks like a concrete niche offering that fits a software consultancy’s portfolio and is unlikely to be withdrawn so quickly.

A building data digital twin service is strategically relevant but, as it was only briefly mentioned, it appears more experimental and therefore has a somewhat higher risk of being discontinued if demand stays limited.
Authentication and identity delegation are core enterprise needs, so this service likely supports broader solution sales and is worth keeping unless adoption is clearly weak.
An open GIS application development framework is closely aligned with a geospatial software firm’s long-term platform and consulting business, making early withdrawal relatively unlikely.
The explicitly announced identity and access service for GIS applications appears to be a strategic integration product in the firm’s core domain, so management would likely continue backing it.
